text: Job planning is now off (f80b05a), so the planner and critic do not run. Keep the explicit model and effort per role in config and on every invocation record, for all roles. Move the hard-job escalation to the producer: a reading that judges a job hard (for example one changing landing, the history check or records) picks a stronger producer model or higher effort, with the reason recorded; an ordinary job keeps the default. Show first-pass verification rate, landed share and cost per landed job by producer model and effort in athena status.
